description: Russia launches a large-scale attack on Kyiv, killing at least 12 people.
A Russian strike hits a railway depot, killing six railway workers.
Ukraine attacks the Novatek terminal in Ust-Luga, causing a large fire.
Andrei Klepach, chief economist at Russia's state development bank, loses his job after a speech on the war's economic costs.
King Haakon VIII swears an oath of allegiance before the Norwegian parliament.
King Harald V of Norway dies.
Haakon becomes king of Norway after the death of Harald V.
Queen Mette-Marit misses the oath ceremony because of complications after her lung transplant.
King Harald V's funeral is held in Oslo.
